fields.name: buffer_chunk_size
fields.description: Set the buffer size to store incoming syslog messages. Memory is allocated on demand in chunks of this size rather than allocating the maximum allowed upfront. When using udp or unix_udp mode, this also sets the maximum message size.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum buffer size to receive a syslog message. If not set, the default size is the value of buffer_chunk_size.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the TCP framing format. Set to octet_counting for RFC 6587 compliant octet-counting framing, or newline for newline-delimited framing. Only applies to TCP modes (tcp or unix_tcp).

fields.name: listen
fields.description: If mode is set to tcp or udp, specify the network interface to bind.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Defines transport protocol mode: UDP over Unix socket (unix_udp), TCP over Unix socket (unix_tcp), tcp, or udp

fields.name: parser
fields.description: Specify an alternative parser for the message. If mode is set to tcp or udp, the default parser is syslog-rfc5424. Otherwise, syslog-rfc3164-local is used. If your syslog messages have fractional seconds, set this parser value to syslog-rfc5424 instead.

fields.name: path
fields.description: If mode is set to unix_tcp or unix_udp, set the absolute path to the Unix socket file.

fields.name: port
fields.description: If mode is set to tcp or udp, specify the port to listen for incoming messages.

fields.name: raw_message_key
fields.description: Specify the key where the original raw syslog message will be preserved.

fields.name: receive_buffer_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum socket receive buffer size. If not set, the default value is OS-dependent, but generally too low to accept thousands of syslog messages per second without loss on udp or unix_udp sockets. On Linux, the value is capped by sysctl net.core.rmem_max.

fields.name: source_address_key
fields.description: Specify the key where the source address will be injected.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own thread.

fields.name: unix_perm
fields.description: If mode is set to unix_tcp or unix_udp, set the permission of the Unix socket file.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.
